50/S0.subgoal: Describe the goals and research stages for developing a realistic walking behavior model in VR navigation.

50/S1.subgoal: Describe the empirical research process used to collect real-life walking data.

50/S2.subgoal: Explain the data analysis process and the identification of the 'slow in, slow out' (CISO) walking pattern.

50/S3.subgoal: Describe the mathematical formulation of the walking model using Fourier series and visual gain.

50/S4.subgoal: Summarize the empirical study results validating the model's effectiveness and summarize the main points of the lecture.
